newsitem.title: YEMEN: First Yemen woman named to senior government job.
newsitem.headline: First Yemen woman named to senior government job.

text.p: Conservative Yemen broke decades of male-dominated government on Thursday by appointing its first woman to a senior post, state-run television said.
President Ali Abdullah Saleh issued a decree appointing Amat al-Aleem Al-Sousah undersecretary at the Ministry of Information.
Sousah, in her 40s and a mother of two, had served in the ministry before her appointment and attended many Arab information and media conferences. She also read the news on television for years.
Women in Yemen, among the Arab world's most impoverished states, have limited roles in government.
